note: v56.99 — Shared GPT-6 Luna with one monthly $10 budget; explicit personal provider ownership, current FMP contracts, weighted credits, native provider transport and queued translation (P1410–P1412). Production provisioning and deployment remain operator-owned.

p.title: Native provider transport and lossless concurrent translation handoff
p.symptom: The new provider adapter grew a legacy hotspot and its UI dependency did not select the Cloudflare QA group. A browser translation fixture also revealed that news arriving during another translation batch could be dropped.
p.root_cause: Provider contracts lived in a growing classic file, gate dependencies lacked complete impact coverage, and the translation busy branch returned without preserving the new items.
p.fix: Move FMP normalization, timeout transport and weighted Twelve Data reservations into an injected native module. Preserve the legacy line-count ratchet, cover every declared gate input, and explicitly request quarterly analyst estimates. Queue new translation items during active batches and drain them after completion; the browser fixture waits for the correlated item to complete.
p.violated_rule: R620 decomposition ratchet; P1173 QA dependency reachability; P1410 completed shared-provider response validation.
p.prevention: ci-extension-api-runtime-check imports the real native transport with injected fixture boundaries. ci-decomp-hotspot-check and ci-qa-pipeline-contract-check enforce structure and reachability; ci-ai-chat-public-route-browser-check exercises queued translation completion.
p.verification: The native provider fixture, decomposition ratchet, QA registry reachability and offline Responses browser fixture pass. Real provider answer quality and deployed route behavior remain unverified.

qa.text: P1412: native personal-provider transport preserves runtime contracts without legacy growth; its dependencies select QA, and concurrent translation items reach completion.

changelog: **API 구조와 번역 동시성 (P1412):** 개인 API 전송·정규화를 native ESM으로 분리하고 QA 의존성 누락을 수정. 번역 중 새 기사 요청을 대기열에서 이어 처리하며 분기 전망의 API 기간을 명시.
